description: Source code for Zephyr shell command processing, including command execution, history, autocompletion, and input handling.

methods.name: receive_state_change
methods.description: Inline function to change the receive state of the shell.

methods.name: cmd_buffer_clear
methods.description: Clears the command buffer in the shell context.

methods.name: shell_internal_help_print
methods.description: Prints help and subcommands if help is enabled.

methods.name: cmd_precheck
methods.description: Checks if argument count is valid and optionally prints help.

methods.name: state_set
methods.description: Sets the shell state and handles prompt and buffer accordingly.

methods.name: state_get
methods.description: Returns the current state of the shell.

methods.name: selected_cmd_get
methods.description: Returns the currently selected command if command selection is enabled.

methods.name: tab_item_print
methods.description: Prints a tabulated item for autocompletion or options.

methods.name: history_init
methods.description: Initializes command history if enabled.

methods.name: history_purge
methods.description: Purges command history.

methods.name: history_mode_exit
methods.description: Exits history mode.

methods.name: history_put
methods.description: Stores a command line into history.

methods.name: history_handle
methods.description: Handles command history navigation (up/down).

methods.name: completion_space_get
methods.description: Calculates available space for command completion.

methods.name: tab_prepare
methods.description: Prepares arguments for tab completion.

methods.name: is_completion_candidate
methods.description: Checks if a candidate string matches the input prefix.

methods.name: find_completion_candidates
methods.description: Finds all matching command candidates for autocompletion.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Performs autocompletion for a command argument.

methods.name: str_common
methods.description: Finds common prefix length between two strings.

methods.name: tab_options_print
methods.description: Prints all options matching the input prefix.

methods.name: common_beginning_find
methods.description: Finds common beginning among command candidates.

methods.name: partial_autocomplete
methods.description: Performs partial autocompletion based on common prefix.

methods.name: exec_cmd
methods.description: Executes the active command with given arguments.

methods.name: active_cmd_prepare
methods.description: Prepares active command and help entries for execution.

methods.name: wildcard_check_report
methods.description: Checks wildcard command processing and reports errors.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main command parser and executor, handling subcommands and wildcards.

methods.name: tab_handle
methods.description: Handles autocompletion when Tab key is pressed.

methods.name: alt_metakeys_handle
methods.description: Handles Alt key meta-commands.

methods.name: ctrl_metakeys_handle
methods.description: Handles Ctrl key meta-commands.

methods.name: process_nl
methods.description: Determines if a newline character should be processed.

methods.name: ascii_filter
methods.description: Filters ASCII characters based on configuration.

methods.name: state_collect
methods.description: Main input loop, reading characters and handling input states.

methods.name: transport_evt_handler
methods.description: Handles transport layer events for RX/TX signals.

methods.name: shell_log_process
methods.description: Processes log backend messages.

methods.name: instance_init
methods.description: Initializes shell instance, context, and backend.

methods.name: instance_uninit
methods.description: Uninitializes shell instance and cleans up.

methods.name: shell_signal_handle
methods.description: Handles shell signals by invoking registered handlers.

methods.name: kill_handler
methods.description: Handles termination of the shell thread.

methods.name: shell_thread
methods.description: Main thread function for the shell, processing signals and events.

methods.name: shell_init
methods.description: Initializes the shell, creates thread, and sets up context.

methods.name: shell_uninit
methods.description: Uninitializes the shell, optionally with callback.

methods.name: shell_start
methods.description: Starts the shell, enabling input and printing prompt.

methods.name: shell_stop
methods.description: Stops the shell, disables input.

methods.name: shell_process
methods.description: Processes input buffer and executes commands.

methods.name: shell_backend_get_by_name
methods.description: Retrieves a shell backend by its name.

methods.name: shell_vfprintf
methods.description: Vprintf-like function for formatted output to shell.

methods.name: shell_fprintf
methods.description: Formatted output to shell.

methods.name: shell_hexdump_line
methods.description: Prints a line of hex dump.

methods.name: shell_hexdump
methods.description: Prints hex dump of data.

methods.name: shell_prompt_change
methods.description: Changes the shell prompt string.

methods.name: shell_help
methods.description: Prints help message and command list.
